interpretation_limits: One live sample per assigned fraction, not an attack probability.
Assigned model capability is separate from actual abnormal choices and signed violation evidence.
If both orders register in this round, identity ordering fixes Alice before Bob; no arrival-fairness claim.
Application-level choices only: no modified consensus voting or secret-share collusion.
Snapshot and later audit heights/evidence counts may differ; neither is silently substituted.
A stalled or excluded order has no pairwise order; zero executed orders is a vacuous prefix check.
Independent wait controls do not reproduce exact consensus scheduling.
